blocks.text: wait for NFC card set runtime var [RUNTIME_VAR] to IDm
blocks.description: Waits until a card is read and stores its IDm in a runtime variable.

blocks.text: wait for NFC card set runtime var [RUNTIME_VAR] to IDm and broadcast [MESSAGE]
blocks.description: Waits until a card is read, stores its IDm, and broadcasts a message.
Returns the most recent NFC IDm read by this extension.
